author: Christian Valdez
title: Armed man peeks through 911 caller's tent in Fresno, police say - NewsBreak
text:
By Christian Valdez ,
4 hours ago
FRESNO, Calif. ( KSEE/KGPE ) - Officers arrested a man who was allegedly looking through a tent with a firearm in Fresno on Thursday, according to the Fresno Police Department.
Officers were called out to the area of Maple and Thomas avenues around 2 a.m. concerning a report of an armed man who was looking through the reporting party's tent.
The person who called 911 gave a comprehensive description of the subject and where he was going. Officers were able to quickly find the suspect, who was traveling near Maple Avenue near the Freeway 180 overpass.
The man, who was later identified as 25-year-old Miguel Aguilar Yepez, was walking with a backpack in that area when officers approached him. Yepez immediately dropped the backpack as soon as officers contacted him.
Miguel Aguilar Yepez
As a result, an officer picked up the backpack and noticed it was partially open. Police saw a concealed firearm in the partially unzipped bag, according to the department. Yepez is a restricted person who is not allowed to possess firearms.
Officers then arrested the 25-year-old and took him to Fresno County Jail on firearm charges, officials say.
